notes.title: Find a Home
notes.content:
Players now have an island to call their own. When a player reaches the current end of the main storyline they will unlock the ownership of an island. You will have the ability to build up and customize your island with lots of choices. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/21a72124cf5dd563df246825a794dfa357673ab9.png[/img]

The Island is separated into plots. Each plot has several options of what you can build on it. Once you have built your new building you can continue to upgrade it increasing its beauty and usefulness. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/6fd58ac043ad5675e3777099a85df33bbdd71631.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/251c3804971ea102961e6f03c7f84131b4f700e7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/6b0ef1f17e4cae65cf5e88124ae6c5e1dea3ce08.png[/img]

[h2]Types of plots:[/h2]
[b]House:[/b] This is the plot you gain by default where you will build your captains house. Upgrading this plot gives you access to your other plots. 
[b]Cave:[/b] The cave is a great place to store some of your treasures.
[b]Field:[/b] The field might be a great place to raise animals or grow food.. 
[b]Dune:[/b] The dunes could be a great place to set up a business.
[b]Beach:[/b] The beach would be a great place to set up some services.
[b]Peninsula: [/b]The peninsula will give the player access to new mystical arts that will greatly increase their power in the game, [b]however this feature will be coming in a later patch[/b].  

If you load an old save the game will automatically teleport you to your new island to get you started. 

The main storyline is still a work in progress and expect to see more in coming patches.


[h2]Additional Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have streamlined and improved the opening tutorial section of the game creating a better starting experience
[*] The red line showing the cannon fire direction will dim while your cannons are reloading
[*] Selling stolen goods to anyone will give you a small amount of pirate factions
[*] Trap Item icon changed
[*] Ships will no longer incorrectly show their flag as the same tier as they player and instead it will be based on the power of the ship
[*] Fixed several UI bugs regarding the swap button for crafting
[*] Fixed bug where ships could keep talking and keep moving after being sunk
[*] Fixed bug where zone would quickly fill with pirates during tutorial
[*] Reduced the sight range of NPC ships
[*] Fixed graphical bug where ghost ships invincibility phase graphics would appear on forever
[*] And squished more small bugs than we could count
[/list]

notes.title: Ancient Ghost Ships
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/e05fe6cb48f7209b97695b623f6272843c923e31.jpg[/img]
This patch brings a new kind of enemy to fight. These ghost ships will appear at night and attack any ship they find. Unlike normal enemies the ghosts have new unique abilities that make even the best ship captain worried. 

These ghosts will eventually be tied into the main story, but for now you can hunt them at night and enjoy their high value unstolen cargo. 

[h2]Ghost Abilities:[/h2] 
[h3]Ghostly Shroud:[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/261abb6267ba67d840db3dc9f1d8f22cf3391600.jpg[/img]
Ghost ships will cover themselves in a ghostly shroud that makes them invulnerable to cannon fire, but beware they can still fire on you.

[h3]Ghost Storm: [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/377e0fa678e4acba7d81842509f4b182f898f815.jpg[/img]
Ghost ships can cause a ghostly storm to spawn above their ship. The storm will charge up over time and then explode with a large burst of energy that will convert all ships nearby into ghost ships. If you're not careful the sea can quickly fill with ghost ships bent on your destruction. The player can attack the ghostly vessel while it's charging up, but if they are hit by the explosion their ship will be destroyed.

notes.title: New Crafting System
notes.content:
In the recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1064320/view/2201641355720515706]Loot Overhaul Patch v 0.2.5[/url], we added a way for some docks to be able to produce items by selling them for much needed supplies. We have revamped this feature by adding a whole new crafting UI which will allow you to easily craft items at producing docks. This system is built in such a way that we can use it for many different activities and can be added using the quest editor. Getting to know docks now has a large financial incentive.

To accompany this change we have completely overhauled the economy. Now more valuable items are far more rare than they used to be. Merchants will almost always give you a decent price for your goods and will sell items at a higher price. Producers will now always give you good prices for your items that they need for crafting, making you choose between crafting or making quick cash.

These changes aim to foster getting to know an area and establishing profitable trade routes, which is a major goal of ours while developing Ferret Scoundrels.


[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
Fixed a bug where ships would get stuck and continue to reoccur in each zone.
Fixed a bug in the tutorial where boarding the surrendered ship would sometimes not work correctly. 

[h1]Quest Editor Changes:[/h1]
Added the following nodes: [url=http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/#Create%20Recipe%20Event%20Craft]Create Recipe Event Craft[/url], [url=http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/#Create%20Recipe%20Item%20Craft]Create Recipe Item Craft[/url], [url=http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/#Create%20Value%20Event%20Craft]Create Value Event Craft[/url], [url=http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/#Create%20Value%20Item%20Craft]Create Value Item Craft[/url], [url=http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/#Show%20Crafting%20Window]Show Crafting Window[/url], [url=http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/#Remove%20Craft]Remove Craft[/url]

The Editor FAQ can be found here: [url=https://www.ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/]https://www.FerretScoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/[/url]

[h2]v0.2.8b hotpatch[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the map would not show other zone locations.
[*] Added ability to see Crafting Recipes to map
[/list]

notes.title: New Lands
notes.content:
Our new lands patch brings with it tons of new islands, dock types, and quests! We apologize for the long wait for this patch. This patch adds a lot of new content, and we had to move our office recently which had a large impact on our timeline. We are grateful to everyone who is keeping up with Ferret Scoundrels during this time and we appreciate your support.  

[h1]New Islands[/h1]
We have added many new islands including a new type of island we are calling continents. Continents are huge islands that hold many more docks than most islands and are a good place to get lots of trading and questing done. 

[h1]New Docks [/h1]
We have added several new types of docks you can explore and do business with.
[h3]Bootlegger:[/h3] Specializing in trading spirits, bootleggers will make more booze for you if you bring them certain ingredients.

[h3]Trapper:[/h3] Traders in exotic animals, Trappers sell all kinds of valuable and rare creatures. With the right tools, they can go out and trap new animals to replenish their collection.

[h3]Forger:[/h3] Need help washing stolen goods? These scoundrels  can convert all of your stolen goods into legitimate cargo for a price. (Pirate merchant docks no longer have this functionality).

[h3]Treasure Hunters:[/h3] These adventurous ferrets explore ancient temples looking for exotic treasure and historical artifacts. They will require maps of the ancient ruins to avoid all the traps and pitfalls to lead you to the treasure. 

[h3]Barber:[/h3] Want a clean shave or a new hairstyle? All hair and fur cosmetics are now sold at the barber. (Tailors no longer have this functionality).

[h3]Cartographer:[/h3] This dock has gained some new functionality allowing you to bring the map pieces we added in the last item patch which they will assemble into a map showing you to the treasure for a small fee. 

[h1]Quests[/h1]
With the addition of the quest editor in patch 0.2.0 and after all of the fine tuning that has gone into its development, we plan to add many new quests more consistently throughout development. We don't want to spoil the fun, but we have added a number of new quests in this patch and many more to come. 

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug around input tracking that was breaking the tutorial. 
[*] Fixed a bug that was not allowing players to turn in letter during the tutorial stalling out the quest line. 
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing ferrets to remain visible on the island after you construct the raft during the tutorial.
[*] We removed the development "fast travel" functionality that had made its way into the live client 
[*] Updated boss ships to guarantee more items and better drops which was not working as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing timers in quests to display incorrect times.
[*] Made Zoning more consistent which got rid of errors for zoning because of storms.
[/list]

notes.title: Loot Overhaul
notes.content:
[h2]New items[/h2]
Added over 70 new items to the game. Including several meat related food items for all you ferret lovers out there. These new items are all able to be traded and will be integrated into more quests and functionalities in the future. 

We added a new classification of item which are Artifact items. Artifacts will generally be very valuable and rare items. 

[h2]Treasure Maps[/h2]
We added several treasure map items to the game. Many of these maps have different pieces. If you can find all of the pieces of a treasure map bring them to a cartographer who will reveal the treasures location for you. 

[h2]Progression Overhaul[/h2]
Along with more rare items we have reworked the level progression from the ground up. Now ships will increase in level the further you have traveled from the starting zone. Along with this new level progression more valuable loot will also drop in higher numbers in distant zones. This level increase will become more and more powerful as you travel so you will be forced to buy new ships or upgrade your current ship in order to explore the higher level zones. 

[u][i]Warning to all current players, your ship may end up under powered for the zone you are in depending on how far you have traveled. [/i][/u]

[h3]Bosses[/h3]
We added boss ships to the game. Bosses will spawn in each zone and will be higher level than most ships in that zone. They will also have a bonus to drop rarer loot. 

[h3]Loot Balance[/h3]
We balanced item drops to make more valuable items more rare then they currently are. The goal being to stratify the items across the whole game so you don't usually find the most valuable items in the game from the starter zone, however it is not impossible. 

[h3]See-through Sails[/h3]
We now have see through sails. This version of the see through sails is not perfect and we may go back and change it at a later date.

[h3]Miscellaneous [/h3][list]
[*] Rafts are no longer a common enemy in the game. 
[*] Fixed several quest bugs 
[*] Fixed Item production for Fruit Merchants 
[*] Added New items to production docks
[/list]

[h2]Quest Editor[/h2]

Added documentation to the quest editor. This documentation should hopefully help users better understand how the quest editor works. You can see this documentation on the web at
[url=http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/ ]http://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/ [/url]
or in the editor itself by mousing over the nodes themselves.

notes.title: Storms Overhaul
notes.content:
In this patch we overhauled the storm system completely. Storms originally would randomly spawn when you transitioned to another zone and would randomly teleport you away from your current zone. Now stormy weather can spawn on its own at any time. The longer you remain in a storm the higher the chance you will be blown off course and show up in a new zone will be increased. You can safely wait out storms by finding shelter near an island. Storms will now also apply wind forces to your boat making traversing the see quite difficult especially if you are traveling into the wind. Enjoy getting blown to far off islands and traversing intense storms. 

In the future we plan on adding more content into storms that will make risking them worth it, stay tuned. 

[h2]Additions[/h2]

[h3]Ferret Scoundrels:[/h3] [list] [*] Storms no longer spawn when traversing to a new zone they can spawn at anytime
[*]The longer you stay in a storm the higher your chance to be blown of course will be You can seek shelter from a storm by sailing near an island dock 
[*]Storms now have updated graphics 
[*]Storms will apply wind forces to your boat making sailing in the storm dangerous 
[*]Storms will now only blow you up to 3 zones away down from a max of 10
[/list]

[h3]Quest Editor:[/h3] None

notes.title: Added New Tutorial
notes.content:
When we originally added our quest editor, we had to disable our original tutorial as it was incompatible with the new system. We have updated our Quest Editor with new nodes and functionality in order to re-create the tutorial. These new updates to the quest editor add lots of new functionality including camera moves, cosmetic customization and AI controls. 

In order to play the new tutorial you will need to make a new game. 

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[b]Ferret Scoundrels:[/b]
Added Tutorial back into the game.

[b]Quest Editor:[/b]
Added several new nodes including:
[list]
[*] AI Controls 
[*] Camera Controls 
[*] The ability to target ferrets on ships and islands
[*] Cosmetic Changes 
[*] and more
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.0 Quest Editor and Holiday Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34900097/00fb88e57d416e9c12ffa91966ec5571d885f424.jpg[/img]
In this large update we took the very big step of completely rebuilding our questing system to allow for quests to be built by you the players. A large part of this process was building our own quest editor that allows you to build your quests. Through the quest editor, quests can be uploaded to our new steam workshop page. From the workshop page you can subscribe to new content created by the community and it will automatically be loaded into the game the next time you play. We will be releasing documentation on the quest editor over the coming weeks which can be seen here 
[url=https://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/]https://ferretscoundrels.com/EditorFAQ/[/url]. The quest editor will become a tool on Steam that can be installed separate from the main game, but in the meantime you can launch the quest editor as an option when you run the game.

Since this update completely changes our current quest system old saved games will no longer work and you will need to start a new game. We are also going to disable the tutorial for the foreseeable future. 

We re-added all of the existing quests back into the game using the quest editor and many of them have been updated with additional content. As this is technically new content please report any bugs you find so we can fix them promptly 

Along with these new quests we have added a new item production system to producing docks. Producing docks like lumber mills will now be able to make more lumber if you bring them certain resources. This can allow players to build up effective trade routes and add more reward for discovering new islands. 

We have also added some new Holiday cosmetics that will be unlockable via chests for the next week. So have a happy Holiday season on the seven seas. 

Bug fixes:
Fixed a bug that was causing the item dragging to not work correctly in lower resolutions

Fixed issue of item not spawning on ships for quests.
Fixed issue of player ship not reacting to quest items.

notes.title: Patch v0.1.1 A Brand New Art Direction
notes.content:
We are currently in the process of converting to a new artistic direction in Ferret Scoundrels. We do not want to stray too far from our original simplistic stylized look, but instead our aims are to add a little more visual diversity. You can see in the image below the new art style is still simplistic but has way more detail than our original art. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/1cb88625b4940ba3fff465d2e2193081697938e2.jpg[/img]

This is going to be an ongoing process as we update all of the art in the game. With this current patch we will just be updating the wooden houses as well as a few other wooden elements. This is still a work in progress however we feel very good about the direction the game is going in. Please feel free to give us feedback or let us know if you see any bugs in the new art features.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/786e806452cb7ddd33a577dad289ad754e5c2c63.jpg[/img]

Your feedback is very much appreciated, please join the discussion on our discord at FerretScoundrels.com/discord

notes.title: Patch v0.0.9 World Map
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/7c9a45099c9c77deb5cbce0d9d98184fdc78f5ce.jpg[/img]

The following changes have been added in Patch v0.0.9

[h1]Added World:[/h1]
You can now return to zones you have visited previously. When you travel to a new zone you will no longer always be swept up in a storm, you will simply travel to the next zone. You could then turn around and head back to the previous zone if you desired. Zones will keep their quests so you can return to a zone to complete a quest at any time. 

[h1]World Map:[/h1]
The map has been rebuilt and now has new functionalities. You can now look at a world map which will show you each zone you have traveled to. Each Zone will be depicted by a square. The zone you are currently in will be colored green and have the map ship symbol in it. You can click on a previously explored zone from the world map which will show you the local map of that Zone. Quest markers will only show in the map that you are currently in.

[h1]Storms:[/h1]
When you leave a zone there is a small chance you will be swept up in a storm. The storm will blow you off course and leave you in a random zone. This zone can be far away from any previously explored zones. 

[h1]Independence Day celebration has ended:[/h1]
You can still equip any cosmetic items you unlocked during the Independence Day celebration.


[b]This was a fairly large and complex patch, so there could be unforeseen bugs.[/b] If you run into any bugs, please do send us a message on our discord [url=https://discord.gg/aR9fSPB]here[/url] or leave us a comment on this announcement. Thank you so much.

notes.title: Patch v0.0.7 Faction Skill Tree and New Abilities
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/ed2a492b238178687997981c4a43ac8278355a4e.jpg[/img]

The following changes have been added in Patch v0.0.7

[h1]Decreased effect of waves on cannon firing.[/h1] This small change makes cannon shots far more accurate and predictable. 

[h1]Added Faction Skill Tree:[/h1] By pressing the F key you can now see the new Faction Skill Tree. This menu will show players all of the potential abilities they can unlock by leveling up a specific faction. This is just the first implementation of the skill tree and changes will most likely be made in the future. In order to unlock a new skill you must travel to a faction representative and ask them about your faction perks. You can only change your skills from these NPC's however you can equip a skill to your ability bar at anytime. You can only have one ability active per tier for each faction. You will now no longer gain new flags and abilities by default when you level up your faction. If you lose a faction rank it will disable the ability, however the ability will still be selected and will re-enable when you regain your faction rank. 

[h1]New HUD elements:[/h1]
We have added several new HUD elements. To hide and unhide these new elements simply toggle the tab key.

[b]Ability Bar: [/b]Along with the new skill tree comes a new ability bar. This bar will allow you to cast the various abilities you will gain throughout your journey. To equip an ability simply drag the ability icon from the Faction Skill Tree Window onto the bar. To use the ability simply press the indicated key named on the slot. 

[b]Effects Bar:[/b] Along with the new skills come effects. You character can gain both positive and negative effects from their new abilities. 

[b]Compass:[/b] While sailing you will now see a new compass element. The compass conveys several pieces of information. The compass will show you the direction you are heading by the cardinal directions ring. The Arrow in the center of the compass shows you the wind direction relative to your ship. The Wooden bar wrapped around the top of the compass displays the current hp of your ship. 


[h1]Abilities: [/h1]
We have added several new abilities as wells as converted some existing abilities to use the new Faction Skill Tree System. 

[b]Trade Flag: [/b]
The Trade Flag allows you to trade with ports. You are unable to fire your cannons while flying the Trade Flag and also gain a bonus to Movement Speed.

[b]Combat Flag: [/b]
The Combat Flag allows you to attack ships with your cannons and loot enemy vessels.

[b]Surrender Flag:[/b] 
The Surrender Flag signals that you no longer wish to fight. Ships that were attacking may cease fire and board your ship. While Surrendered you will travel slowly and repair your ship.

[b]Pirate Flag:[/b]
While flying the Pirate Flag, other pirate ships will see you as an ally. You will also be able to attack and loot ships. You generate double Pirate Faction while flying the Pirate Flag.

[b]Admiralty Flag:[/b]
While flying the Admiralty Flag, other Admiralty ships will see you as an ally. You will be able to attack and loot ships. You generate double Admiralty Faction while flying the Admiralty Flag.

[b]Guild Flag:[/b]
While flying the Guild Flag, you will receive all of the benefits of the Trade Flag and generate double Guild faction.

[b]Ambush: [/b]
Ambush will change your ships flag to the Pirate Flag, Threatening all nearby non-pirate ships, and will give you a 20% damage bonus for 15 seconds. You can cast Ambush only if your ship is not flying the Pirate Flag and if any nearby ship has not seen your Pirate Flag before.

[b]Smuggler's Run: [/b]
While you have illegal or stolen goods on your ship, your movement speed is increased by 25%. If you sell any illegal or stolen goods to a merchant you will gain an additional 25% movement speed bonus for 3 minutes. If you throw any illegal or stolen goods overboard or lose them to the admiralty, your ship will lose 50% movement speed and all movement bonuses from this skill for 3 minutes or until you successfully sell an illegal item to a merchant.

[b]Terrifying Reputation:[/b]
After you sink a ship, you will gain a bonus chance to steal a ship for the next 10 minutes. The bonus amount is based on the type of ship you sunk.  
Raft: +5%
Sloop: +10%
Galleon: +15%
Manowar: +20%

[b]Intimidate: [/b]
While flying the Pirate Flag, you can Threaten a ship by looking at it and pressing the Interact Key. Enough Threat may cause ships to surrender to you or run away. Your Threat Amount is based on your Pirate faction points.

[b]Brow beat: [/b]
Items pillaged from a Surrendered ship are no longer considered Stolen. Illegal items are still considered Illegal.

[b]Risky Maneuvers: [/b]
Your ship will slow down and turn very quickly for a short period of time.

[b]Pirate Legend: [/b]
Your Intimidate ability recovers 30% faster.

[b]Command Ship:[/b]
You can now board other Pirate vessels and attempt to 'Convince' them to follow you.

[b]Defense Pact:[/b]
Fire off a flare to call upon your allies to join the fight against all nearby Pirates. In order to use this ability you must be using the Guild Flag and there must be at least one nearby Pirate.

[b]Company Expansion:[/b]
While flying the Guild flag and docking for the first time at an Uninhabited island you gain 50 Guild faction and 100 gold.

[b]Quick To Run:[/b]
Remove the move speed penalty for sailing while Surrendered.

[b]Maritime Merchant:[/b]
While flying the Guild flag you will now be able to board other ships and initiate business with them. Some ships might even give you valuable trade information about other islands

[b]Acceptable Losses:[/b]
Every time you throw an item overboard you have a small chance to have enemy ships leave you alone. Throwing cargo overboard gives you a 15% movement speed bonus that lasts for 30 seconds.

[b]Sterling Reputation:[/b]
If you sell at least 30,000 gold worth of goods in a zone you gain the Sterling Reputation Effect. This Effect will decrease the cost of upgrading and purchasing new ships by 1% per 100 guild faction. Leaving this zone causes you to lose this Bonus.

[b]Business Magnet:[/b]
You will find more valuable items throughout your journey.

[b]Paid Protection:[/b]
While flying the Guild flag you can pay a Guild ship to follow you and offer protection.

[b]Tactical Retreat:[/b]
Increases Movement Speed by 50% for 30 seconds. You will not be able to fire your cannons for the duration of this ability.

[b]No Mercy:[/b]
While flying the Admiralty flag, if you sink a Pirate vessel that is currently Surrendered, you gain extra Admiralty faction.

[b]Swift Justice:[/b]
When you are Damaged by a ship that you have not attacked, you gain 30% increased Damage, Repair Speed, and Turn Speed for 15 seconds.

[b]Board And Search:[/b]
You can board ships and attempt to confiscate any illegal or stolen goods you find.

[b]Model Soldier:[/b]
Whenever you board a ship and confiscate illegal cargo you will gain the Model Soldier Effect. When you turn in illegal or contraband items to the Admiralty you gain a 1% per 100 Admiralty faction chance to get a chest. This Effect is stack able and all stacks of this Effect will add together for your check. If you succeed or fail you will lose all stacks of the Model Soldier Effect.

[b]Never Surrender:[/b]
If your ship is at 30% or less health you will deal 50% increased damage and threat for 20 seconds.

[b]Combat Repairs:[/b]
While active you will heal 10 hp per second, but your cannons will deal 50% reduced damage for 30 seconds.

[b]Outrank:[/b]
You can attempt to order any Admiralty ship to follow you.


[h1]Item Rebalance:[/h1]
All items have had their value and rarity balanced. In general more valuable items should be rarer and there should be more diversity in prices between items. 


[h1]Bugs:[/h1] 
Fixed bug where enemy ships were not boarding the player in the tutorial properly.
Fixed bug where docking at the ship merchant would break the tutorial.

notes.title: Patch v0.0.6 Zone Saving
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/01269791f4667b8eca3d684510f661d4638bda7a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Added Zone Saving[/h1] 
The game will now save the current zone you're in. This includes quests, so you should be able to turn off your game without losing any progress. However, once you leave a map you will no be able to return to it, so make sure you finish any quests you want to before you leave your current zone.


[h1]Additional Changes[/h1] 
[list]
[*] Fixed blurry text on ship quest markers 
[*] Mouse no longer auto centers and clicks when you tab back into the game. 
[*] Fixed a few quest bugs. 
[*] Fixed a pirate island which had more taverns that was intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.5 - Smuggling Items and Spyglass update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/75f30e4fd6f0940c6b8f8403a348abc69abc7c66.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Admiralty no longer overwhelm the player demanding multiple times to search for stolen cargo.
[*] Admiralty no longer demands to search for stolen cargo if the player is actively in combat.
[*] There is now a difference between Stolen and Contraband Items
[*] Rum and Cider are now considered Contraband Items.
[*] Contraband items cannot be converted into legal items at a pirate merchant. 
[*] Looting Cargo that you just dropped is no longer is considered stolen when picked up by you.
[*] Improved Spyglass Rotation.
[*] Spyglass now can Zoom in and out.
[*] Removed 'quick view inventory' menu.
[*] Map Icons now Stack Better.
[*] Generated Raft Stats have been changed.
[*] Added camera zoom objective to tutorial.
[*] When respawning after being sunk, your ship name correctly shows as Scavenged Wreck.
[*] Tutorial Bug Fixes (addressed some conditions which would cause the tutorial to be incompleteable)
[*] Cosmetic Items being Duplicated should now be fixed.
[*] When canceling zoning to a new map, we fixed an error where you could be thrown into an island and killed.
[/list]

notes.title: Ferret Scoundrels is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/22733b6151120ff380a37da63204bdaffb2e76ec.jpg[/img]

[h1]We are proud to announce that Ferret Scoundrels is now officially in Early Access.[/h1]
Thank you to everyone that has given us feedback and supported the development so far.


[h1]This is just the beginning[/h1]
With such a great community already, We know that we will be able to do great things together. We plan on adding more content and exciting new features with involvement from the community.


[h1]All hands on deck[/h1]
Please help us out, by spreading the word of our release, and feel free to join us in [url=https://discord.gg/aR9fSPB]Discord[/url] or here on Steam.

We're excited for what the future will hold!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announced: May 9th, 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900097/80cd82e43a29ae62a0f6caed3b74e701f5b1747d.jpg[/img]

We are proud to announce that we will be releasing Ferret Scoundrels on [b]May 9th in Early Access[/b]. A few weeks ago we released a free demo to the public to get feedback from the community. The demo was a great success, we got tons of feedback and we have already started adding new features and squashing bugs. We will be taking down the free demo on May 9th, so if you want to try it for free (and haven't already) you still have a few days left.

[h1]The Future of Ferret Scoundrels[/h1]
With the communities help, we have already implemented new features and quality of life improvements. A big addition is an introductory story, which lays the foundation for an ongoing adventure and helps introduce new players to the game. The release into Early Access is just the beginning of our journey. We'll be adding more and more content and functionality to the game over time with input from the community.

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We would like to thank our biggest supporters on [url=https://discord.gg/aR9fSPB]discord[/url] and steam for giving us so much feedback and motivation to make Ferret Scoundrels the best game that is can be, and we're excited to bring the game into Early Access.
